businessDifference.conflictSummary: 旧实现把 post-accept Title 完整轮询放在 Dialog 白字分类之前，随后又在 Dialog wait 中持续让 Title/rearm 抢占，明确的 TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE 动作不能立即结束该轮。
businessDifference.userDecision: 每次接任务点击只发一代后台 Title snapshot，并与一张 fresh Dialog 分类联合决断；暂不可用模板明确命中立即短路 Title、点 Story 并重放。两者都 UNKNOWN 才允许一次 fresh 复判，视觉等待不占全局 turn。
businessDifference.cardReference: docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md#G101-五环接任务单次联合判定与后台放权2026-08-24

connectivity.producer: Client exact-window Runner publishes one requested Title snapshot and one fresh Dialog presence/frame generation after each accept click.
connectivity.transport: Existing observation interests, exact-HWND prepared-frame demand and PreparedDialogActionState carry Title fact or VERIFY_WHITE_TEMPLATE without holding the task turn.
connectivity.consumer: FiveRingTaskV3 consumes the first explicit Title/Dialog result, prioritizes TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE as the immediate Story-replay branch, and permits only one UNKNOWN fresh recheck.
connectivity.ordering: accept click under turn -> release -> one Title snapshot plus Dialog-only classification -> Title present succeeds OR TEMP template dismisses/replays -> both unknown permits one fresh joint recheck -> second unknown retires the scene instead of rearming Title forever.

proves: Each accept click owns one Title snapshot generation and explicit template result ends the wait.
Visual wait releases the exact task turn before parking; only Story/input execution reacquires it.
Dialog classification can be armed without creating a continuous Title interest.
The Title request remains an explicit one-shot snapshot boundary.
